questions.stem: What is the main purpose of baking soda in baking?
choices: To produce carbon dioxide for rising
To increase the colour of the food
questions.solution: Baking soda reacts to produce carbon dioxide, which creates bubbles in the dough or batter, causing it to rise and become light and fluffy. The other options are incorrect because baking soda does not add sweetness, make food bitter, or significantly affect color.

questions.stem: What is the chemical formula of washing soda?
questions.solution: Washing soda is a hydrated form of sodium carbonate, which has the chemical formula Na2CO3.10H2O. This formula indicates that each molecule of sodium carbonate is associated with ten molecules of water. Other options represent different substances, such as baking soda (NaHCO3) and common salt (NaCl), which are not washing soda.

hi.stem: वॉशिंग सोडा का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
hi.solution: वॉशिंग सोडा सोडियम कार्बोनेट का जलयोजित रूप होता है, जिसका रासायनिक सूत्र Na2CO3.10H2O होता है। यह सूत्र दर्शाता है कि प्रत्येक सोडियम कार्बोनेट के अणु में दस अणु पानी संलग्न होते हैं। अन्य विकल्प अलग-अलग यौगिकों का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं, जैसे कि बेकिंग सोडा (NaHCO3) और साधारण नमक (NaCl), जो वॉशिंग सोडा नहीं हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms as found in Hindi-medium textbooks.

mr.stem: वॉशिंग सोडा चे रासायनिक सूत्र काय आहे?
mr.solution: वॉशिंग सोडा सोडियम कार्बोनेट चा जलयुक्त रूप आहे, ज्याचे रासायनिक सूत्र Na2CO3.10H2O आहे. हे सूत्र दर्शवते की सोडियम कार्बोनेट च्या प्रत्येक अणूला दहा अणू पाणी जोडलेले असतात. इतर विकल्प वेगवेगळ्या द्रव्यांना दर्शवतात, जसे की बेकिंग सोडा (NaHCO3) आणि सामान्य लवण (NaCl), जे वॉशिंग सोडा नाहीत.

questions.stem: What is the use of sodium hydrogencarbonate in antacids?
choices: To increase the acidity of the stomach
To neutralise excess acid in the stomach
To make the stomach feel warm
questions.solution: Sodium hydrogencarbonate is alkaline and reacts with excess acid in the stomach to neutralise it, which is the main function of antacids. The other options are incorrect because increasing acidity would worsen the problem, producing carbon dioxide is a side effect, and making the stomach feel warm is not a chemical purpose of the substance.

questions.stem: Which of the following is an example of a base?
questions.solution: Baking soda solution is a base because it has a pH greater than 7 and can accept protons. Vinegar and lemon juice are acids, as they have a pH less than 7 and release protons. Acetic acid is also an acid, not a base.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन एक क्षार का उदाहरण है?

hi.critique: Translation is accurate and maintains the scientific terminology used in Hindi textbooks.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते एक बेसचे उदाहरण आहे?

questions.stem: If a solution turns red litmus blue, what can be said about the solution?
questions.solution: If a solution turns red litmus blue, it is basic. Bases cause red litmus to change to blue, while acids keep it red. Neutral solutions and salts do not cause this color change.

questions.stem: If a solution has a pH of 3, what can be said about its hydronium ion concentration compared to a solution with a pH of 6?
choices: It has a higher hydronium ion concentration
It has a lower hydronium ion concentration
It has the same hydronium ion concentration
questions.solution: A solution with a pH of 3 has a higher hydronium ion concentration than a solution with a pH of 6 because pH is inversely related to hydronium ion concentration. Lower pH values indicate higher concentrations of hydronium ions. The other options incorrectly suggest either a lower, equal, or nonexistent hydronium ion concentration, which contradicts the logarithmic nature of the pH scale.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a correct statement about the reaction between an acid and a metal?
choices: It produces a salt and hydrogen gas
It produces a base and water
It produces a salt and water
It produces a base and hydrogen gas
questions.solution: The correct statement is that it produces a salt and hydrogen gas, as acids typically react with metals to form these products. The other options are incorrect because bases are not produced in such reactions, and water is not a direct product of an acid-metal reaction.

questions.stem: Which of the following salts is formed from a strong acid and a strong base?
questions.solution: Potassium sulphate is formed from a strong acid (sulphuric acid) and a strong base (potassium hydroxide), making it neutral. Sodium acetate is from a weak acid and strong base, ammonium chloride from a strong acid and weak base, and magnesium hydroxide is a base, not a salt.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा लवण एक मजबूत अम्ल और एक मजबूत क्षार से बनता है?
hi.solution: पोटैशियम सल्फेट एक मजबूत अम्ल (सल्फ्यूरिक अम्ल) और एक मजबूत क्षार (पोटैशियम हाइड्रॉक्साइड) से बनता है, जिसके कारण यह उदासीन होता है। सोडियम एसीटेट कमजोर अम्ल और मजबूत क्षार से बनता है, अमोनियम क्लोराइड मजबूत अम्ल और कमजोर क्षार से बनता है और मैग्नीशियम हाइड्रॉक्साइड एक क्षार है, लवण नहीं।
hi.critique: Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate technical terms as per Indian curriculum.

questions.stem: A solution reacts with crushed egg-shells to give a gas that turns lime-water milky. What does this indicate about the solution?
questions.solution: The reaction with egg-shells, which are made of calcium carbonate, produces carbon dioxide gas that turns lime-water milky. This indicates the presence of an acid in the solution. A strong acid would produce this reaction. A weak base, neutral solution, or salt solution would not react in the same way.

hi.stem: एक विलयन चूने के छोटे टुकड़ों के साथ अभिक्रिया करके एक गैस देता है जो चूने के पानी को दूधिया कर देती है। इससे विलयन के बारे में क्या संकेत मिलता है?
hi.solution: अंडे के खोल जो कैल्शियम कार्बोनेट से बने होते हैं, के साथ अभिक्रिया करके कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड गैस उत्पन्न करता है जो चूने के पानी को दूधिया कर देती है। इससे विलयन में अम्ल की उपस्थिति का संकेत मिलता है। एक मजबूत अम्ल इस अभिक्रिया को उत्पन्न करेगा। एक कमजोर क्षार, उदासीन विलयन या लवण विलयन इसी तरह की अभिक्रिया नहीं करेगा।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, structure, and terminology. All options and the solution are correctly translated and maintain their original intent and correctness.

questions.stem: Which of the following salts, when dissolved in water, will have the highest pH?
questions.solution: Sodium hydroxide is a strong base and will have the highest pH when dissolved in water. Sulphuric acid and acetic acid are acids, and magnesium hydroxide is a strong base, but sodium hydroxide is more soluble and completely dissociates in water.
